subject: Nitish Setu, and the question of the next U-turn
alt: Satish Acharya’s cartoon: at the left stands a policeman in a khaki uniform and cap, hands behind his back, moustachioed; behind him a yellow board on the wall reads ‘NITISH SETU’ in black letters. At the right stands a maroon car, and the driver in a blue shirt leans out with his right index finger raised; his speech bubble reads, ‘SIR, HOW FAR IS THE NEXT U-TURN?’ Satish Acharya’s signature is at the lower left.
chutki: The board by the bridge says ‘Nitish Setu’, and the driver leaning out of his car asks the policeman: ‘Sir, how far is the next U-turn?’
The needle: the bridge is named after the leader, and the question is about his next U-turn. The name on the board reminds the driver less of a road than of a habit of changing course.
